newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Spain and South Korea seek closer business ties.
newsitem.headline: Spain and South Korea seek closer business ties.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam and Spain's King Juan Carlos on Monday pledged to expand economic ties, a presidential spokesman said.

The king, who arrived Seoul on Sunday for a five-day visit, said he hoped for expanded South Korean investment in Spain, while Kim asked for increased Spanish investment in South Korea's aerospace and auto industries, the spokesman said.
Seoul and Madrid established diplomatic relations in 1950.
